about: B1e (18 Nov 2026): the model never says whether we deliver to a place. Delivery areas, fees and times come only from the database (invariant 7, as for prices). sim-021 of QA1's sim-test (run 44154789374, Arabizi, at night then the morning, Botmeh): the model said three times that Botmeh has no delivery ('ma 3ando tawseel', 'Ma fi tawseel la Botmeh', then in English 'we don't deliver to Botmeh'), while the code's own answer, from resolve_place, was «✅ إيه منوصّل على بطمة … $1.50». The plan's issue was no_delivery_village, which means only that no village is known yet. The output guard (packages/agents/src/output-guard.ts, area_claim) refuses a sentence that says we do or do not deliver somewhere unless a tool returned that place, with that answer, this turn (`areas`). The same reply in English to an Arabizi customer is refused too (wrong_language: the model writes in the conversation's language). Run by packages/agents/test/area-claim-b1e.test.ts and, through the turn, test/db/area-claim-b1e.test.ts.
